description: Disaster Risk Development Implications Index in the GHA region is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. A holistic approach has been used for risk assessment purposes where, using as input data the direct physical losses estimated in a probabilistic manner at country level and combining them with a set of indicators that account for lack of resilience and social fragility conditions which can aggravate the consequences in case a disaster occurs ... Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2019-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
